field_types.role: string: copy assignment role; spec/standards is the review axis
field_types.ticket: string: copy assignment ticket, including leading zeros
field_types.attempt: integer: copy assignment attempt; booleans/floats are invalid
field_types.revision: string: copy assignment revision (starting source for implementation)
field_types.result: string: submitted or human-decision-needed; never Done
field_types.changed_files: list of nonempty strings; claims only, may be empty
field_types.checks: list of nonempty strings; claims only, may be empty
field_types.acceptance_evidence: list of nonempty strings; nonempty for submitted
field_types.unresolved_questions: list of nonempty strings; nonempty for human-decision-needed
field_types.findings: list of complete finding objects; may be empty

finding_field_types.id: nonempty string; stable and unique within this review

report_contract.instructions: Emit one JSON object to stdout; diagnostics go to stderr. Copy assignment identity fields exactly, including their JSON types. Identity fields and fields listed in fields are required. Every finding requires finding_fields. Maximum object/array nesting: 100 levels. No duplicate keys or nonfinite numbers. Extra diagnostic metadata is allowed but has no authority.

spec.assignment.json.instructions: Review the exact revision against the approved ticket/spec and actual check results. Do not edit source. Return findings classified as blocking or optional. For unavailable requirements or changes to approved contracts, return a blocking finding with human_decision_needed true. Identify the approved contract in requirement, supporting evidence/consequence, and the precise decision in resolution. Do not resolve the conflict by changing approved inputs or interfaces.
